model_annotation: This plot illustrates the coverage of llamas in relation to the number of completions. The x-axis, labeled “Number of completions (k)”, is a linear scale ranging from 20 to 28 with tick intervals of 1. The y-axis, labeled “Coverage”, is a linear scale ranging from 0.78 to 0.83, with tick intervals of 0.02. A solid blue line, marked with circular blue markers, represents Llama-3B + FT and begins at approximately 0.78 at k=20 and decreases to approximately 0.79 at k=28. A dashed green line, marked with triangular green markers, represents Llama-3B and begins at approximately 0.63 at k=20 and decreases to approximately 0.68 at k=28. A dotted light green line, marked with square light green markers, represents Llama-1B and begins at approximately 0.42 at k=20 and decreases to approximately 0.48 at k=28. A solid light green line, marked with star light green markers, represents Llama-1B + FT and begins at approximately 0.40 at k=20 and decreases to approximately 0.45 at k=28.
